{{Quote|It is with great disappointment that I implement the following verdict. By decree of the Muun people, the five representatives standing before me are found guilty of embezzlement. They shall be imprisoned forthwith, and control of the banks shall transfer immediately to Rush Clovis, under the guidance of the Muun government.|The judge removes the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] from power and appoints [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] as head of the Banking Clan|<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>}}
A '''Muun judge''' served the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] when the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] were accused of embezzling funds intended for assistance to war refugees. The judge found the Core Five guilty of embezzlement and removed them from power, replacing them with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]].
